route.why: Soft-landing arrival day, then a full day for Fort Kochi's heritage quarter.
Tea country needs a sunrise and a full estate day — one night is never enough.
Periyar is one strong day of boat safari or forest walk — a second night repeats it.
One overnight on the water, boarding at Kumarakom, cruising to Alleppey by morning.
The wind-down stop near the airport, with a genuinely unstructured day built in.

days.label: Arrive Kochi
days.body: Land, transfer to the hotel and rest. No sightseeing scheduled — the soft-landing day the whole pace of this trip is built around.

days.label: Fort Kochi
days.body: A full day on foot through the heritage quarter — Chinese fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town — closing with an evening Kathakali performance.

days.label: Drive to Munnar
days.body: A scenic ~4-hour hill drive via waterfalls and roadside spice stops. Arrive by mid-afternoon; the rest of the day is free at the estate.

days.label: Munnar, full day
days.body: Eravikulam National Park at sunrise for the Nilgiri tahr, then a guided tea-estate walk and tasting in the afternoon.

days.label: Drive to Thekkady
days.body: A relaxed ~3.5-hour drive via Kumily, arriving for lunch. Afternoon spice-plantation walk; evening Kalaripayattu and Kathakali double bill.

days.label: Periyar, then Kumarakom
days.body: An early boat safari on Periyar Lake for the best light and wildlife odds, then on to Kumarakom to board the houseboat before dusk.

days.label: Overnight houseboat
days.body: Cruise the Vembanad backwaters from Kumarakom, meals cooked onboard, mooring before dusk. Disembark at Alleppey for Marari Beach.

days.label: Marari Beach, unstructured
days.body: Nothing booked — the trip's built-in free day. Just the beach and the property.

days.label: Depart
days.body: Transfer to Kochi airport, roughly 1.5–2 hours from Marari.

stays.name: Brunton Boatyard (CGH Earth)
stays.why: Waterfront colonial shipyard conversion with harbour views onto the fishing nets — the reference pick.

stays.name: Windermere Estate
stays.why: A small, independently run plantation-bungalow property with genuinely personal service.

stays.name: Spice Village (CGH Earth)
stays.why: Cottage rooms set in a working spice garden, closest in feel to the afternoon's plantation walk.

stays.name: Private kettuvallam houseboat
stays.why: A converted rice barge with dedicated crew and cook, booked directly for consistent quality and safety.

stays.name: Marari Beach Resort (CGH Earth)
stays.why: The original cottage-style resort, right on the fishing village beach it's named for.
